intro.title: Welcome to Your Fitness Journey
intro.paragraph1: Located at the BCIT Recreational Center in Burnaby, I specialize in helping women and fitness beginners discover their strength through personalized, encouraging training sessions.
intro.paragraph2: No judgment, no intimidation - just support, guidance, and celebration of every achievement along the way.

services.title: Personal Training Services
services.subtitle: All sessions are conducted in-person at the BCIT Recreational Center, Burnaby, BC
services.description: Perfect for fitness beginners and those looking for personalized guidance in a supportive environment.

whatToExpect.title: What to Expect in Your Sessions
points: Personalized programming based on your fitness level and goals
Focus on proper form and technique to ensure safety
Gradual progression at a comfortable pace
Education about exercises and fitness principles
Regular progress assessments and program adjustments
